### 4. Scored parameters

- Members' cushion: Tailwise Plus Annual active, 6 scheduled shipments in 12 months -> cushion 7 days (replaces 14) -> 56 + 7 = 63.
- Life stage: Bruno (pet of the existing Autoship) holds Senior Dog Wellness Plan active -> 2 days off -> 61.
- Recent customer skips, last 6 months: 1 -> 2 days off -> 59.
Units: 59 / 30.33 = 1.945 -> **2 units**.
Fall-back (computation doc only): 18/52 = 0.346 -> 20.22 d/unit; 70/20.22 = 3.46 -> 4 units.

**(B) Weeks between shipments of Maple's new Everyday** — computation doc "Weekly Usage and Shipment Spacing for a Second Pet on the Same Item": household = scheduled units last 6 months /26; existing covers units/weeks; new pet = difference; days = units per shipment x 7/new-pet usage - transit (Everyday 2); /7 floor; 1..26. Units per shipment = "the same units per shipment as the existing Autoship carries" = 2 after (A).
- Settled household usage: rose; 3 scheduled shipments in last 6 months -> "3 or more" -> all shipments incl. ship-now last 6 months: 4+4+1+4 = 13 / 26 = 0.5/week.
- Existing covers 2/8 = 0.25 -> new pet 0.25 -> unit lasts 28 days -> 2 x 28 = 56.

- Ship-now on the existing Autoship (6 months): 1 -> -3 -> 48.
- Customer skips on the existing Autoship (6 months): 1 -> +7 -> 55.
- Growing pet: no Puppy/Kitten plan; Adult Dog Wellness Plan active enrolled 192 days ago -> -2 -> 53.
- Training treats: enrollment in progress with 4 sessions attended in last 1 month (later than 2026-09-06) -> +9 -> 62.
62 / 7 = 8.86 -> **8 weeks**.
Fall-back (computation doc only, units 2): 12/26 - 0.25 = 0.2115 -> 33.09 d -> 66.18 - 2 = 64.18 -> 9 weeks. With the un-re-sized quantity 4: existing covers 4/8 = 0.5 >= household usage, so the new pet's usage is zero or negative and no frequency is computable.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Only enroll Maple" is excluded by the P0 sentence above ("only after ... re-sized") and numerically (with 4 units, step (c) gives no positive usage for the new pet).
- Alternatives excluded: new quantity = existing Autoship's units (hub), not a fresh estimate; first ship date = customer's chosen date (hub "its first ship date is the date the customer chooses"), the customer chooses Bruno's next delivery 2026-11-23; re-size keeps frequency and next ship date ("The item, the delivery frequency and the next ship date stay unchanged"); Bruno's plan, not Maple's, decides the life-stage factor ("Only the plan of the pet the existing Autoship is linked to counts"); Maple's training sessions count since the enrollment is in progress.
- Fall-back numbers: 4 units / 9 weeks, both differ from 2 / 8.
- Factor findability: each factor doc names its record kind (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus record; Vet Clinic Wellness Plans; Tailwise Training records; existing Autoship's skips/ship-now/replacements) and the subscription scope; reached from record words.
